title: Lacson urges Marcos: 'Referee' Senate, House during bicam for 2027 budget
summary: Senator Panfilo "Ping" Lacson on Saturday urged President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. to mediate between the House of Representatives and the Senate as the 2027 budget process reaches the…

blocks.text: Senator Panfilo "Ping" Lacson on Saturday urged President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. to mediate between the House of Representatives and the Senate as the 2027 budget process reaches the bicameral conference.

Lacson's statement came hours after the Senate announced early morning Saturday that it had finished marathon deliberations for the proposed P7.2-billion national budget at 1:25 a.m. The House of Representatives' version of the budget bill, also amounting to P7.2 trillion, was passed back in October.

"Ako'y nananawagan sa kanya, makialam kayo dito. Langit at lupa ang diprensya, ang agwat ng House at Senate version. Marami siyang kaalyado sa Senate and House, siya ang pwede maging referee para mapatino ang 2027 budget," Lacson said in a radio interview.

(I am calling on the President to mediate. The difference between the House and Senate versions of the budget bill is like heaven and Earth. The President has allies in both Houses of Congress. He can act as referee to make sure the 2027 budget is clean.)

After the House of Representatives was flagged by budget watchdogs for allegedly making insertions into the 2027 budget, the Senate trimmed several items in its own version. Among the Senate's reductions is P97 billion from the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) due to noncompliance of several projects.
Lacson had flagged several questionable items in the budget, including alleged misplaced budget priorities such as P247 billion in "ayuda" or government aid.
The House's questionable allocations could make it appear that Marcos has lost control of the budget, Lacson said.
Lacson said priorities should not be realigned, especially with the current economic difficulties that the Philippines was facing.
Items such as the Financial Assistance to Local Government Units (FALGU), which have been previously tagged as presidential pork due to being a lump-sum, could be realigned to more pressing needs.
"Kaya malaki ang dapat na role ng Pangulo. Pagkasunduin muna at this point, hindi after, ang House and Senate at economic managers. Mag-usap-usap kami. We will talk," Lacson said.
(The President has a big role to play. He has to mediate and have economic managers meet with the Senate finance committee and House appropriations committee at this time, not after the bicam.)
GMA News has reached out to Malacañang regarding Lacson's call, but it has yet to respond as of posting time. — VDV, GMA News
